patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Campaign Monitor and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Campaign Monitor and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Campaign Monitor only if your buying job matches “Design-led email marketing by Marigold with contact-tier Lite, Essentials, Premier, and En” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Campaign Monitor's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Campaign Monitor is shaped for Design-led email marketing by Marigold with contact-tier Lite, Essenti whereas Mailjet is shaped for EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending wit. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Campaign Monitor and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Campaign Monitor is Design-led email marketing by Marigold with contact-tier Lite, Essentials, Premier, and Enterprise.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Company-size focus: Campaign Monitor (small-business, mid-market) vs Mailjet (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Campaign Monitor — No forever free plan — trial only; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — Campaign Monitor: No forever free plan — trial only; Lite monthly send caps force upgrades for frequent senders; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: Campaign Monitor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever free plan — trial only · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid Campaign Monitor if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
